crossRefs.note: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.
For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
“Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my…
You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for…
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

translations.web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
translations.bsb: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
translations.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
translations.asv: I remember God, and am disquieted: I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah
